Local OCR: Tesseract.js 6.0.1, tesseract.js-core 6.1.2 (Apache-2.0).
Source: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
Source: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
English and Simplified Chinese LSTM language models:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tesseract.js-data/eng@1.0.0/4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tesseract.js-data/chi_sim@1.0.0/4.0.0_best_int/chi_sim.traineddata.gz
Models from Tesseract OCR tessdata, Apache-2.0.
All OCR assets are served by this site. Images are processed in a browser worker and are not uploaded or persisted.
